title: Staley v. North Texas
disposition_detail: Complaint found out of order because Mr. Staley lacked standing, as he is not a member of a PCA church; no merits reached. Roll-call vote: 19 concur, 0 dissent, 0 abstain, 5 absent.
first_summary: A complaint by Thomas Clark Staley against North Texas Presbytery was found out of order because Staley lacked standing as a non-PCA-church member. The SJC did not reach the merits; the vote was 19 concur, 0 dissent, 0 abstain, with 5 absent. This short record states only the standing ground and does not identify the challenged presbytery action.
